Two tales of Victory Day
2013-12-16T00:00:24+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/two-tales-of-victory-day

People of Atghoria upazila in Pabna district will pay homage to the Liberation war martyrs at the temporary memorial in front of the upazila parishad complex on the Victory Day today, as no steps were taken to build a permanent memorial after laying its foundation stone in 2001.

Defying physical challenge, Salauddin Sheikh Lion sells the National Flag, sitting on the road island near Shaheed Satu Hall in Chapainawabganj town.
